headline: Noida's high-rise fire risk: Why air conditioners are emerging as a safety concern
full_text: Noida's high-rise fire risk: Why air conditioners are emerging as a safety concern. A major blaze erupted in a flat on the 12th floor of a high-rise tower at Ivy County residential society in Sector 75, while a second fire was reported at a paying guest accommodation in Shatabdi ... Within minutes of each other, two fire incidents were reported from different parts of Noida on Friday morning, keeping emergency services on high alert. A major blaze erupted in a flat on the 12th floor of a high-rise tower at Ivy County residential society in Sector 75, while a second fire was reported at a paying guest accommodation in Shatabdi Vihar, Sector 52. Firefighters rushed to both locations and launched rescue and firefighting operations. The latest incidents come amid growing concerns over fire safety during the peak summer season. Notably, on May 22, a fire had broken out on the 27th floor of the same Ivy County society, reportedly due to a short circuit in an air-conditioner unit. According to a Hindustan Times report, Noida has recorded 88 AC-related fire incidents over the past two months, underscoring the risks posed by overworked cooling systems, faulty wiring and inadequate maintenance during periods of extreme heat.
